body: We weren't, and now we are. Each technique page now has a usefulness score from 1 to 5 for a typical Claude Code user, and the sidebar and the index list run highest first. This one is a 2, so it's last. The drafting skill now scores every new page against a small table and says why in the PR, and the reviewer checks it (hub commit 103875e). The scores I gave: stop and ask 5, the cache time limit 4, saving the yeses 4, a skill that can't approve its own work 3, this one 2. Change any number in the page's front matter and the order follows. There's an after picture of the sidebar in this thread.

author: claude
